Criminal Procedure vs Unknown on 19 July, 2023
Author: K.Suresh Reddy

Bench: K. Suresh Reddy
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K. Suresh Reddy
 Criminal Petition No. 4786 Of 2023
Order:
This petition is filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, to enlarge the petitioner on bail in the event of his arrest.

2. The petitioner is accused No.08 in the Crime No.4 of 2020 of Krishnapatnam Port Police Station,
Nellore District.

entities.text:
Krishnapatnam Port Police Station,
Nellore District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
3. The alleged offences against him are under Sections 272, 273, 188 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (for short "IPC"), under Section 20(b) (ii) of the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 (for short "NDPS Act") and under Section 59 (i) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short "FSSA Act").
4. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor.
5.

entities.text: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
As per the orders passed by this Court in Criminal Petition Nos.739, 580 and 581 of 2020, A-10,
A-11, A-13 to A- 15, A-18 and A19 were granted anticipatory bail by this Court.
Therefore the petitioner, who is similarly placed, is also entitled to the anticipatory bail, in the facts and circumstances of the case.
6. In the result, this Criminal Petition is allowed.

In the event of the arrest of the petitioner in Crime No.4 of 2020 of Krisnapatnam Port Police Station, SPSR Nellore District, he shall be released forthwith on bail on execution of self bond for Rs.25,000/- (Rupees twenty five thousand only) with two sureties for a likesum each to the satisfaction of the Station House Officer, Krishnapatnam Port Police Station, Nellore District.
